title: Nothing Happens
description: The uprising pauses. Footsteps fade. For a moment, you are alone between factions.

effects.message: The halls stay quiet — for now.

title: Undead Patrol
description: Resurrected inmates sweep the corridor in a loose pack. You duck aside — not without cost.

effects.message: An undead patrol forces you to duck aside — you lose a card from your hand.

title: Find Herbs
description: Bitter prison moss grows between stones near the old gallows. It steadies the nerves.

effects.message: You gather herbs and recover a discarded card.

title: Anarchist Stash
description: A loose brick hides a forgotten revolutionary cache. Someone meant to come back for this.

effects.message: You pocket a small cache and recover two discarded cards.

title: Gallows Ambush
description: A hanging corpse drops from the rafters. You fight free, but not without cost.

effects.message: A hanging corpse ambushes you — two cards are lost from hand.

title: Whispered Rumor
description: A half-mad inmate whispers of faction lines — Anarchists, Guards, and a sorcerer's trail.

effects.message: The rumor points you toward nearby chambers.

title: Collapsed Corridor
description: Stone groans as the uprising shakes the foundations. Dust fills the air.

effects.message: Falling rubble forces a hard scramble — you discard a card.

title: Guard Whistle
description: A surviving watchman signals. Order still holds a pocket of the fortress — for now.

effects.message: You note which halls the living Guards still claim.
